core_step: Extract key frames (I-frames) from /root/super-mario.mp4 and save as /root/keyframes_%03d.png using ffmpeg
why_essential: Key frames are the required inputs for subsequent grayscale conversion, object counting, and CSV reporting; without extraction there are no frames to process.
evidence: ffmpeg -i /root/super-mario.mp4 -vf "select='eq(pict_type,I)'" -vsync vfr /root/keyframes_%03d.png; "4 key frames were extracted."

core_step: Convert all extracted key frames (/root/keyframes_001.png .. /root/keyframes_004.png) to grayscale inplace using ImageMagick
why_essential: The task requires frames be edited in-place to grayscale before counting; this state change is mandatory for following object detection steps.
evidence: for f in /root/keyframes_001.png /root/keyframes_002.png /root/keyframes_003.png /root/keyframes_004.png; do convert "$f" -colorspace Gray "$f"; done && echo "Done"

core_step: Count coins in /root/keyframes_001.png using template /root/coin.png with object_counter
why_essential: Counting coins per frame is required for the CSV; each frame's object_count must be obtained via the object_counter tool.
